errors.diskFull: The server's disk is full. Free some space on it, then try again.
errors.toolMissing: {tool} isn't installed on the server, or isn't on its PATH.
errors.jsRuntimeMissing: YouTube needs a JavaScript runtime to hand over a video, and the server has none. Install Node 22 or newer on it, or import the file instead.
errors.jsRuntimeFailed: Akapela couldn't run the JavaScript YouTube needs to hand over a video. Try Update yt-dlp in Settings, then retry.
errors.videoUnavailable: YouTube won't hand over this video. It may be private, removed, age-restricted, or blocked where the server is.
errors.sourceNotFound: There's nothing to import at that link.
errors.sourceIsPlaylist: That link is a playlist. Paste the link to a single video instead.
errors.ytDlpFailed: yt-dlp couldn't import this, usually because YouTube changed under it. Try Update yt-dlp in Settings, then retry.
errors.ytDlpDownloadFailed: Akapela couldn't download yt-dlp, which it fetches the first time you import from YouTube. Check the server's connection, then retry.
errors.modelDownloadFailed: The Separation Model {model} couldn't be downloaded. Check the server's connection, then retry.
errors.audioUndecodable: That file couldn't be read as audio.
errors.unsupportedUpload: Akapela can't import that type of file. Import an MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, or OGG file.
errors.invalidYoutubeUrl: Paste a link to a single YouTube video, like https://youtu.be/xxxxxxxxxxx
errors.lyricsProviderUnreachable: {provider} couldn't be reached. Try again later, or try another Lyrics Provider.
errors.lyricsProviderUnavailable: {provider} isn't set up on this Akapela. Pick another Lyrics Provider.

descriptions.wav: Uncompressed. The largest, and what every Track used before.

descriptions.Inst_Main: Fastest. Clean enough for most songs; stops at 17.6 kHz.
descriptions.Inst_HQ_3: About 1.5× slower. Cleaner instrumentals across the full range.
descriptions.Inst_HQ_4: About 1.2× slower. The newest instrumental model, full range.
descriptions.Kim_Vocal_2: About 1.5× slower. Listens for the voice, so less of it is left behind; stops at 17.6 kHz.

language.heading: Language
language.body: The language Akapela is shown in, on this device only. Lyrics, Track titles, and names you typed are never translated.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.body: How Akapela looks on this device. "System" follows whatever your OS or browser is set to.

lyricsProvider.heading: Default Lyrics Provider
lyricsProvider.body: Where a newly imported Track looks its Lyrics up.

recording.heading: Recording
recording.body: What a new recording session on the Sing page starts with. Either can still be switched for that session alone.

separation.heading: Separation
separation.body: How vocal removal runs. These describe the machine Akapela runs on, which may not be the one you're looking at.
separation.hardware: On this server: {cores} core, {gpu} | On this server: {cores} cores, {gpu}
separation.coresBody: How many cores a Separation may use. Leaving one free keeps recording smooth while a Track separates on the same machine. A change applies from the next Separation to start.
separation.accelerationBody: Separate on the GPU. If it fails partway through, the Separation carries on and finishes on the CPU. A change applies from the next Separation to start.
separation.modelBody: What a Track is separated with unless you pick another for it. None come with Akapela: each Separation Model downloads the first time it's used. A Separation already waiting keeps the one it was asked for.

storage.heading: Storage
storage.formatBody: What each Track's Backing Track and Stems are stored as on the server. Applies to files written from now on; what's already there stays as it is. Takes and Mixes aren't affected.

library.heading: Library location
library.body: The folder holding your database and every Track's files. Choosing another one opens the library that's already there — nothing is moved, copied, or deleted at either end. Akapela restarts to apply it.
library.unusable: That folder could not be used.

ytDlp.heading: YouTube imports
ytDlp.body: Importing from YouTube uses yt-dlp, which breaks whenever YouTube changes under it. If imports have started failing, fetch the latest version — Akapela keeps its own copy, so this is the whole fix.

backup.heading: Backup
backup.body: Everything that isn't re-downloadable — the database, every Track's audio, every Take and Mix. Restoring replaces your entire library with what's in the file.
backup.restarting: Restored. Waiting for the app to come back…
backup.notBack: The app hasn't come back on its own after two minutes. If you're running this in development, restart it by hand (aspire run or pnpm dev) — under docker compose it restarts itself.
backup.confirmMessage: This replaces your entire library — every Track, Take, and Mix — with what's in {file}. This can't be undone, and the app restarts once it's done.

about.heading: About
about.checkingOff: With checking off, Akapela never contacts GitHub on its own; Check now still works.
about.failed: Akapela couldn't check for an Update. Check your connection and try again, or see the {link}.

errorPage.notFoundBody: The link you followed doesn't point anywhere.

updatePrompt.label: An Update is available
updatePrompt.title: Akapela {version} is available
updatePrompt.installFailed: Akapela couldn't install this Update. You can download it yourself instead — your library isn't affected either way.
updatePrompt.ready: Downloaded and ready. Akapela restarts to finish, or installs it the next time you quit.
updatePrompt.restartBlocked: A Job is still running — restarting would start it over. You can install on quit, or wait for it to finish.

trackEdit.title: Edit Track
trackEdit.coverLocked: Cover art can be changed once the Track has finished importing
trackEdit.hint: Cover art can be a PNG, JPEG, or WebP. The Song used to find Lyrics is not changed here.

library.title: Your Library
library.deleteMessage: “{title}” and every file under it will be removed. This cannot be undone.

library.emptyBody: Paste a YouTube link or import an audio file ({formats}) to add your first Track.

songPanel.intro: Confirm which Song this Track is and Akapela fetches its Lyrics.
songPanel.title: Title
songPanel.noMatches: No matches for {artist} · {title}. Edit the artist and title, or confirm what you typed anyway.
songPanel.addArtist: Add the artist too: Lyrics are looked up by artist and title.
songPanel.replaceMessage: Confirming a Song fetches its Lyrics, which replaces the ones typed on this Track.

lyricsPanel.heading: Lyrics
lyricsPanel.summarySynced: Synced Lyrics from {provider} · {count} line | Synced Lyrics from {provider} · {count} lines
lyricsPanel.summaryPlain: Plain Lyrics from {provider} · {count} line | Plain Lyrics from {provider} · {count} lines
lyricsPanel.noSong: Confirm which Song this Track is, or paste the Lyrics yourself.
lyricsPanel.manual: These Lyrics are yours to type. Paste them below.
lyricsPanel.notFound: No Lyrics for this Song on {provider}. Try another provider, or paste them yourself.
lyricsPanel.editHint: One line per line sung. Saving makes these Lyrics yours, so fetching again will ask first.
lyricsPanel.replaceMessage: Fetching from {provider} replaces the Lyrics on this Track with the ones it has.

Yesterday
All my troubles seemed so far away

detail.finishedOnCpu: Finished on CPU: the GPU failed

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: Nothing running. Imports, Separations, and Mixes show up here.

stemsPanel.heading: Stems
stemsPanel.separatedWith: Separated with {model}: an Instrumental Stem and a Vocals Stem.
stemsPanel.intro: Vocal removal splits this Track into an Instrumental Stem to sing over and a Vocals Stem. It runs on the server and takes a few minutes.
stemsPanel.againHint: Separate again with another Separation Model. These Stems stay until the new ones are ready.
stemsPanel.switching: Switching the Backing Track over. It picks up where it was.
stemsPanel.onInstrumental: Singing over the Instrumental Stem. Separation is lossy, so the audio this Track arrived with is kept untouched and is one tap away.
stemsPanel.onOriginal: Singing over the audio this Track arrived with, not its Instrumental Stem.
stemsPanel.deleteMessage: The Instrumental and Vocals Stem will be removed, reclaiming {size}. The Track and everything sung on it are untouched, and separating again will make Stems anew.

takesPanel.heading: Takes
takesPanel.empty: Sing to record your first Take.
takesPanel.renderLabel: Render a Mix from the Take from {date}
takesPanel.deleteMessage: This removes the Take and any Mixes rendered from it. It cannot be undone.

mixList.deleteMessage: This removes the rendered files. It cannot be undone.

player.loadFailed: The Backing Track couldn't be loaded.

record.notLoaded: The Backing Track has not loaded yet.
record.noMic: No microphone was found. Plug one in, then try again.
record.allowHint: Allow it in the browser's site settings, then try again.

review.playLabel: Play the Take over the Backing Track
review.windowTitle: The stretch of the song your Take covers, out of the whole {length}
review.clocks: Two clocks, one playhead: this lane runs {from}–{to} of the song — the stretch marked above, out of {length} — and dragging either lane moves both.
review.balance: The balance between the two, saved on the Take: what you hear here is what the Mix is rendered with.
review.yourVoiceBody: Where your recording sits against the Backing Track. What you sang is stored dry and stays that way.
review.nudgeHint: Moves your voice earlier or later against the Backing Track. Pause, type a figure, then play back to judge the alignment by ear; anything from {min} to {max} ms.
review.nudgeClamped: That is further than the nudge reaches; {applied} was applied.
review.backingBody: Pitch, tempo, and Backing Source only ever shape what you sang over — never the recording itself (ADR 0003).
review.followingTempo: Following tempo, which is locked — pitch can't move on its own.
review.backingSourceHint: Which audio you sang over, overridden for the next Mix only.
review.tempoLocked: · locked, since this Take was sung at this tempo
review.effectsBody: Reverb and Low-pass are one set, and they go wherever this points — so they sit here rather than under either side.
review.effectsDry: Your recording stays dry either way — the reverb is added on the way out, at playback and again in the Mix.
review.notSaved: Review settings could not be saved: {reason}
review.discardMessage: This removes the Take. It cannot be undone.
